title: Jude and the Bell
author: Quentin Iversen
blurb: Sable Eriksen, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the harvest moon rises.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
